user.title: Connect an EasyStart
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address while the EasyStart is powered and advertising. Close the OEM app so it can accept a connection.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Connect {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Confirm setup while this EasyStart is powered. Its model will be checked before an entry is created.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read this EasyStart. Check that it is powered, an active Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range, and the OEM app is disconnected.
error.invalid_address: Enter an address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.

abort.unsupported_model: This model is not supported for startup-mode control.

init.title: EasyStart options

data.allow_running: Allow explicit startup-mode writes while the compressor is running
data.nominal_voltage: Nominal line voltage (V) for the power estimate
data.power_factor: Compressor power factor (0-1) for the power estimate
data.live_mode: Live mode: hold one connection open for near-real-time current

init.description: Polling requires advertisements. Turn off the Polling switch to pause all reads and writes during OEM maintenance. The pause survives restarts. The Power sensor estimates compressor-only power as current x voltage x power factor; adjust the voltage and power factor to your system. Live mode holds one connection open through a single proxy and reads every few seconds for near-real-time current; it monopolises the unit's Bluetooth (the OEM app and startup-mode writes cannot connect while it is on).

error.invalid_interval: The polling interval must be an integer of at least 15 seconds.
error.invalid_voltage: Nominal voltage must be between 90 and 300 V.
error.invalid_power_factor: Power factor must be greater than 0 and at most 1.
error.invalid_live_interval: The live-mode interval must be an integer of at least 2 seconds.
